preconditions.description: The length of the input string A is between 1 and 30 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string A are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-empty string.
The length of the output string is not greater than the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(output in A for i in range(1, len(A) // len(output) + 1) if A.startswith(output * i))
postconditions.description: The output string is a substring of A and it is repeated the most times in A.

postconditions.expression: not any(all(output in A for i in range(1, len(A) // len(other) + 1) if A.startswith(other * i)) and len(output) < len(other) for other in set(A) if other != output)
postconditions.description: If there are multiple substrings with the same maximal repeat time, the output string has the maximal length.

postconditions.expression: not any(all(output in A for i in range(1, len(A) // len(other) + 1) if A.startswith(other * i)) and output > other for other in set(A) if other != output)
postconditions.description: If there is a tie in length, the output string is alphabetically later than any other substring with the same repeat time.
